state:
- Novelty is mostly a drug substitution into S4’s established DHODH–differentiation mechanism. Check prior teriflunomide/leflunomide AML studies and identify what the clinically achievable exposure hypothesis adds beyond existing work.
- “Differentiation-blocked AML” remains broadly defined, and marker changes with short-term viability do not establish durable differentiation or selectivity. Prespecify sample eligibility, maturation markers, time points, and quantitative AML-versus-normal clonogenic thresholds.
- The claimed separation from oxidative-phosphorylation suppression is not directly tested. Uridine rescue and dihydroorotate accumulation can also accompany respiratory-chain-mediated DHODH impairment. Add time-resolved respiration measurements and target-specific genetic or resistant-DHODH controls; restriction to cytarabine-residual cells alone would not establish a different mechanism.
